script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: THE EDGE OF EXCELLENCE

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Our HERO, JASON (30s, ambitious, determined), sits on the edge of his sofa, staring at a laptop screen. He clenches his fists as he reads an email from his former boss, denying him a promotion at his current job.

JASON: (shouting) No! This can't be it!

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Jason's WIFE, AMY (late 20s, loving, supportive), enters the room. She wraps her arms around him, offering comfort.

AMY: Honey, it's late, and you've been working non-stop for days. Why don't you take a break?

JASON: (frustrated) Break? I can't afford to take a break! I need this promotion to secure our future!

INT. STUDIO - DAY

Jason attends an open house for an art school. He browses the various studios, mesmerized by the creations on display.

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

Jason enters an art class led by renowned artist, PROFESSOR SANCHEZ (50s, wise, passionate). He notices Jason's determination and invites him to join the class.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Amy watches as Jason paints late into the night. She smiles, proud of his newfound passion.

AMY: You've never been happier, have you?

JASON: (smiling) No, I haven't. And for the first time in a long time, I feel like I'm truly making progress.

INT. ART SCHOOL - DAY

Months have passed. Jason graduates from art school with high honors and starts teaching at the same institution. He meets STUDENT A (early 20s, talented, ambitious) who reminds him of himself.

STUDENT A: (admiringly) Mr. Thompson, your work is incredible. I'd give anything to be as good as you someday.

JASON: (smiling) You already are, my dear. Your passion and dedication will take you farther than I ever went.

INT. ART EXHIBIT - NIGHT

Jason's artwork is displayed in a prestigious gallery. Amy and Student A attend the opening, beaming with pride.

INT. PROFESSOR SANCHEZ'S STUDIO - DAY

Years have passed. An aging Professor Sanchez sits in his studio, looking at a portrait he painted of Jason years ago.

PROFESSOR SANCHEZ: (smiling) You were right, my dear student. The edge of excellence is a difficult place to reach, but it's worth every step.

FADE OUT.

THE END
